key.name: auto-check
key.description: Run the metadata-only refresh periodically. Installs are never automatic.

key.name: interval-minutes
key.description: A successful check certifies the state only for this long. Outside it the badge is marked stale.

key.name: timeout-seconds
key.description: Each step (metadata refresh, list scan) must finish within this time or the check fails honestly.

key.name: retry-attempts
key.summary: Retry attempts after a failed check
key.description: Total attempts per check cycle, including the first.

key.name: backlog-count
key.summary: Pending count that turns the badge orange
key.description: Yellow below, orange at or above. A single security update always wins with red.

key.name: pulse
key.summary: Pulse the badge when updates are pending

key.name: notify
key.summary: Show a desktop notification when updates are found
key.description: Failures are never notified; the badge itself is the truth.
